dog.description_text:
Gemini is a 1-year-old mixed breed who weighs around 30 pounds, and she's an incredibly sweet girl who loves being close to her people. She's a big fan of cuddles and will happily snuggle up whenever she gets the chance. And those adorable ears certainly don't hurt!

Gemini is house-trained and does wonderfully in her crate, where she settles in and sleeps comfortably. She can be a little shy when first meeting other dogs, but it doesn't take her long to warm up and feel more at ease around them.

She's also still getting acquainted with all the sounds, movement, and excitement of city life, but she's already making great progress and getting braver every day. With a little patience and encouragement as she continues adjusting, Gemini is ready to be a sweet, snuggly addition to her future family.

Registered adopters interested in Gemini can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you’re not registered yet, you can do it at hbrdogs.com.
